multicast.description: Global multicast settings — but per man page, this maps to listeners/multicast block. Keys like key_file, hash, auth, family belong inside the multicast listener block, not here. Address/port/interface are also in the multicast listener block. We keep this as a top-level variable for convenience but note the mapping in template comments.

multicast.address.description: Multicast IP address to listen on (default: 225.0.0.12, must be in range 224.0.0.0–239.255.255.255).

multicast.interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Empty means all interfaces (default), but setting is strongly recommended for gateway hosts.

multicast.key_file.description: Path to the shared key file (default: /etc/cluster/fence_xvm.key).

multicast.hash.description: Weakest hashing algorithm allowed for client requests (default: sha256; could be sha1, sha512, or none).

multicast.auth.description: Hashing algorithm for challenge-response authentication (default: sha256; could be sha1, sha512, or none).

listeners.description: List of listener types (only one active at a time). Supported: 'multicast', 'serial', 'tcp', 'vsock'. This template supports only 'multicast' via listener_blocks.

listener_blocks.description: Listener-specific configuration blocks — e.g., listeners/multicast {}, listeners/serial {}, etc.

listener_blocks[].name.description: Listener name. Currently only 'multicast' supported by this template.

listener_blocks[].interface.description: Interface to bind to for multicast listener.

backends.description: Backend plugins for fence_virtd (renamed from 'drivers' to match manpage 'backends' section).

backends[].name_mode.description: Naming mode for VMs in cpg backend: 'name' (default, for compat) or 'uuid' (recommended for multi-host clusters).

backends[].namespace.description: Optional libvirt namespace (used only with libvirt backend).

auth.description: Authentication settings — maps to key_file in multicast listener block. The template places key_file at top-level 'auth' for convenience.

auth.key_file.description: Path to shared key file (required for secure communication with multicast listener).

logging.description: Logging configuration — matches manpage but note: fence_virtd does not have a direct 'logging' section in the config file; logging is configured via command-line options or syslog.

logging.file.description: Log file path (use 'syslog' to log to syslog).

groups.description: Static maps of VMs (per manpage 'groups' section). Any member may fence any other in the group.

groups[].ip.description: Allowed IPs for fencing requests (e.g., for multicast). Each is an IP address string.

groups[].uuid.description: VM identifiers (UUIDs or names) in this group.
